title: Add an ailment
summary: New entry in the ailments catalog.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic Catalog → Ailments
steps.details: The diseases and conditions entered in the medical history; those with a high alert level show as an alert on the patient's record.

steps.title: Category
steps.details: Required: groups ailments in the medical history and in reports.

steps.title: Alert level
